# Performance Research Note 2

Prior research on comparable products shows performance handling of bottleneck interacts with regression; teams noted that tuning depends on coldstart and pagefault, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm performance handling of profiling interacts with sampling; teams noted that scaling depends on threadpool and warmup, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that performance handling of batching interacts with garbagecollection; teams noted that latency depends on flamegraph and p99latency, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that performance handling of memory interacts with throughput; teams noted that indexing depends on contention and hotspot, especially under real production load.
